worldcombat.skill.swagger.summary: Enrage one foe: gift it several Attack stages, leave it confused, and pull a non-player target's hostility onto the caster. The enraged foe's attempts may be wasted, and its landed hits recoil on itself using the very Attack it was given; the Attack stages outlast the rage.
worldcombat.skill.swagger.use.0: Pull a heavy hitter's fire onto yourself
worldcombat.skill.swagger.use.1: Open a fumble window on a difficult target
worldcombat.skill.swagger.use.2: Light the target up before your team focuses it
worldcombat.skill.swagger.description.0: Ignite the target's rage: it gains %1$s Attack stages and is confused for about %2$s seconds; it now hits harder, and its rage recoil is amplified by that same raised Attack.
worldcombat.skill.swagger.description.1: While enraged, each attempt has a %1$s%% chance to be lost to fury; each time it lands a hit on a non-ally it suffers rage recoil based on %2$s%% of its maximum health, multiplied by 0.4-2.5 by its current Attack, but never more than %3$s%% of that hit's actual damage.
worldcombat.skill.swagger.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s, range %4$s blocks. A biting taunt adds to the gift and the recoil but shortens the rage; a sneering one does the opposite.
worldcombat.skill.swagger.timing: Short windup and recovery; single target, paced by its cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.swagger.preference.goa: Biting taunt: gift +1 stage, fumble chance +12%%, but rage duration x0.75 and recoil x1.3. Sneering: lighter gift, rage x1.35 and recoil x0.7.
Only consider taunting a threat within this distance; larger opens earlier and risks more counterattack.
When on, the companion leaves its post to taunt.
worldcombat.skill.swagger.description.su: Against non-player targets the taunt also pulls their hostility onto the caster. The Attack stages do not fall away when the rage ends, and recasting keeps stacking Attack while refreshing the confusion; if protection wards off the confusion, the Attack gift still lands.
